ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Psychology of Advertising Meets with ADV 400-R (CRN 55662) Description: This course is designed to familiarize students with theory and research at the intersection of advertising and psychology. It will explore issues such as: basic research methodology, the emergence of trends, attitudes and persuasion, human and brand personality, cross-cultural advertising, implicit consumer cognition, and coolness.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
